Header in shell context:
- Back button, Course title 'Advanced Excel Masterclass', progress chip '68%', student profile avatar.

Inner Content:
1. Video Player Area (16:9 full-width responsive video container):
- Dark slate-950 video viewport showing realistic M-Code/Power Query data transformation code screen and editor mock.
- High-fidelity stream tags: '4K STREAM', 'HD 1080p', encrypted CDN indicator with glowing green dot.
- Watermark security overlay: subtle repeating translucent diagonal watermark 'Rahul Sharma | ID: 10234'.
- Active pause/play centered circle overlay, video progress scrub bar with scrub head positioned at 12:40 / 28:10 (45% played).
- Bottom compact player controls bar: play/pause icon, rewind 10s, forward 10s, timestamp '12:40 / 28:10', speed badge '1.5x', resolution '1080p', fullscreen toggle icon. Explicitly NO download button on video player.

2. Lesson Header & Meta:
- Metadata chips row: Indigo pill badge 'Section 3 • Lesson 4', Category badge 'Advanced ETL', Star rating '★ 4.9 (384)'.
- Big bold typography lesson title: 'Power Query: Cleaning Messy Data'.
- 2-line concise curriculum overview description: 'In this session, learn how to handle irregular header splits, inconsistent date formats, and trailing delimiter errors using native Power Query transformations.'

3. Lesson Attachments:
- Section subheader 'LESSON ATTACHMENTS (2)'
- Two downloadable file cards:
  * File 1: PDF icon with red badge, 'powerquery-cheatsheet.pdf' (2.4 MB • Reference Card), download icon button on right.
  * File 2: Excel spreadsheet icon with green badge, 'practice-dataset.xlsx' (8.1 MB • Raw Source File), download icon button on right.

4. Action Navigation Row:
- Flex row with:
  * Outlined 'Prev' icon button (`< Prev`)
  * Solid vibrant Indigo-600 primary button with checkmark icon 'Mark as Completed'
  * Outlined 'Next' icon button (`Next >`)

5. Bottom Sheet Drawer (Course Content):
- Rounded top container (rounded-t-3xl) with subtle pull-up handle pill bar.
- Drawer header: 'Course content' with list icon and '3/6 completed' pill badge, subtitle 'Section 3: Power Query & ETL • 1h 58m total'.
- Section 3 Lesson items list:
  * Lesson 1: Green circle checkmark, '1. Introduction to M-Code', Video • 14:20, outline play icon.
  * Lesson 2: Green circle checkmark, '2. Extracting Multi-Files', Video • 18:45, outline play icon.
  * Lesson 3: Green circle checkmark, '3. Unpivoting Cross-tab Data', Video • 22:10, outline play icon.
  * Lesson 4: Currently active item with soft indigo highlight background, indigo active play circle, '4. Cleaning Messy Data', 'NOW' badge, 'Active • 28:10', equalizer wave audio/video bars icon.
  * Lesson 5: Inactive numbered circle '5', '5. Custom Columns & Logic', Video • 19:30.
  * Lesson 6: Gray lock icon, '6. Automating Refreshes', 'Locked • Prerequisite 5 • 24:00', lock status badge.

6. Floating Action Button:
- Floating circular or pill notes action button pinned above bottom nav: 'Take Note' or circular pencil icon button in deep slate-900 with white text.

7. Ensure seamless integration with the mobile shell bottom navigation bar: Course home (active), Notes, Resources, Q&A.
